description:
Hey peps! 👋.

For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, I’m interested in developing an Astronaut Health Monitoring System to support astronauts’ physical and mental well-being during space missions. 

I’m looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills or interests in Python, AI/ML, data analysis, web or app development, UI/UX design, and space science research. 

Let’s combine our ideas and build something impactful for space exploration. 🚀
